description: Read the signed-in merchant's website, built and hosted on SiteMe: linked, url, status (generating, done, error, or unknown when SiteMe could not be reached) and last_changed (null when SiteMe has not reported one); or linked: false with state not_linked or not_available and a message. Requires company:read; the account selects the business. Read-only.
name: get_website
title: Get my website
